items.summary: The sources describe a modern desktop development stack using Tauri 2.0, Rust, and ReactJS, emphasizing high performance, lightweight design, and cross-platform capabilities. The tech stack includes Tauri for interfacing between the OS and UI, Rust for system-level performance, and ReactJS for the frontend. The sources also mention the use of TanStack Router for type-safe routing and Tailwind CSS for styling. The focus is on building fast, memory-safe, and secure applications with a small footprint, suitable for productivity tools, offline-first apps, encrypted file managers, and developer utilities. The sources do not provide a definitive answer regarding the specific use of QUIC or any direct mention of "airhand High-performance remote desktop."

items.title: cheap-ag
items.description: 50x your Claude usage with cheap-ag. Opus plans, a dirt-cheap model writes every line, and tests decide what ships. Your $20 plan stops hitting limits. One MCP server for Claude Code.
items.summary: For daily development, the Pro plan at $20/month ($17 billed annually) is sufficient unless limits are frequently hit, in which case the Max 5x plan at $100/month or the Max 20x plan at $200/month may be more appropriate. The Pro plan includes Sonnet 4.6 with standard limits, while Max 5x and Max 20x offer Opus 4.6 with 5x and 20x Pro limits, respectively. For teams, Team Standard is $25/seat annually ($20 monthly) with Sonnet 4.6 and standard limits. There is no free tier, and API usage is pay-as-you-go at $2/$10 per million tokens on Sonnet 5 and $5/$25 on Opus 5.

items.title: Claude-Jailbreak-Prompt
items.description: Full pre-activated desktop edition of Claude AI local tools. Everything included in the installer.
items.summary: To install the full pre-activated desktop edition of Claude AI local tools, visit the Claude downloads page, select the appropriate version for your operating system, download the file, and open it to complete installation. For Mac users, download from macOS; for Windows users, download from Windows. After installation, launch Claude from your Applications folder or Start menu and sign in with your account. The installation includes extensions that integrate with local files, calendars, emails, and messaging apps, and offers enterprise-ready security features.

However, another source from TRM Labs warns that these tutorials are part of a scam where victims are led to deploy a smart contract that forwards their cryptocurrency to the operator, resulting in significant losses. The scam has drained 274.60 ETH from 224 victims between February and August 2026. items.title: couch-tv
items.description: Your own Google TV home screen and phone remote, with an optional Claude assistant. Set it up by handing this repo to your AI agent.
items.summary: The couch-tv project on GitHub provides an Android TV app, `couch-tv-home.apk`, which can be downloaded from the GitHub Releases page or built from the source code. The project includes various components like `bridge`, `docs`, `on-tv`, `remote`, `scripts`, `tv-home`, and configuration files. Additionally, a YouTube video by Lukas Margerie demonstrates using the Rive app CLI for dynamic interactions and creating a custom home screen for a smart TV. TechCrunch reports on the "dumbtv" solution, which is fully customizable and requires pointing an AI agent to the GitHub repository for setup. The dumbtv solution has been tested on various TV platforms including Fire TV Edition and Android/Google TV platforms from Sony, TCL, Philips, Hisense, Xiaomi, and Shield.

items.title: minecraft-ai-mod-builder
items.description: Type what you want built, see it as a blueprint in your Minecraft world, place it in one step and undo it in one. Fabric companion, Paper plugin, free local models, one Windows build.
items.summary: The sources indicate that there are several AI-driven tools available for creating Minecraft mods without coding. EnderDevelopment offers an AI Mod Maker that can create mods for Forge and Fabric, trained on working mods to generate production-ready code. Minedit is an experimental NeoForge mod that uses AI to build and edit Minecraft structures with AI models through OpenRouter or a local bridge. CreativeMode uses AI to turn plain-English descriptions into fully playable Minecraft mods in minutes, with no coding required. The sources do not provide specific details about a Fabric companion, Paper plugin, or a Windows build for a minecraft-ai-mod-builder.

items.title: lancer
items.description: Lancer — desktop AI workspace based on pi-gui and pi
items.summary: Lancer is a desktop AI workspace based on pi-gui and pi, offering a persistent desktop environment for AI-powered coding sessions with full visibility into the agent's actions. It supports multi-workspace sessions, allowing users to open project folders as workspaces with independent session histories. The pi-gui desktop shell is separated from the agent runtime through a durable SessionDriver interface, making the frontend independent of backend changes. The workspace is available in beta for macOS arm64 and Linux AppImage, installable from GitHub Releases or Homebrew on macOS.
